title: Significative
summary: SIGNIF'ICATIVE, adjective 1. Betokening or representing by an external sign; as the significative symbols of the eucharist. 2. Having signification or meaning; expressive of a certain idea or thing. N

inlines.v: SIGNIF'ICATIVE, adjective 1. Betokening or representing by an external sign; as the significative symbols of the eucharist. 2. Having signification or meaning; expressive of a certain idea or thing. Neither in the degrees of kindred were they destitute of significative words.
